text.p: - The new border tax to be introduced later this year could seriously undermine Russia's foreign trade and provoke price hikes.
- Russian businessmen have gate-crashed into politics, showing they no longer want to stay at the mercy of the Kremlin guard.
- Presidential press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky says he has direct contact with President Boris Yeltsin.
- Six people have been taken to hospital over the New Year with bruises, injuries and concussions caused by champagne corks.
